title: Spatial Sampling Framework for Dental Facilities — Riyadh
description: Field-validated census data and R/SAS analysis code for a spatially explicit sampling frame of private dental facilities in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, supporting the manuscript "Validating Dental Sampling Frames in Rapidly Expanding Cities: Riyadh Case" (JDR Clinical & Translational Research). Code is licensed under the MIT License; data under CC BY 4.0. District-level population is withheld under national census (GASTAT) governance; see the repository README for details.
